verdict.rationale: Crossplane is operated entirely through declarative Kubernetes-style API resources that it documents itself: Providers, Functions, Configurations, Composite Resource Definitions, Compositions and managed resources. The vendor explicitly positions these as machine-readable APIs that humans, automation and AI agents can act on, governed by RBAC and usable with standard Kubernetes tooling. The official CLI adds a supported programmatic surface. Missing for 10: no cited API reference or schema documentation for the resource types, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents or automation driving it through the API.
